name: AC1.5 needed-by asked once, then recorded without it when the Foreman cannot say
simulation_scenario: You are Dale, a foreman on the Roster. When the assistant asks what you need, say in one sentence: you need two tri-axle dump trucks at the Route 104 job. Do not say when. If asked when you need them, say you don't know yet. If asked again about when, say you still don't know. When the assistant reads the details back and asks whether to submit, say yes. After it gives you a reference number, say that's all and goodbye.
success_conditions: The agent asks when the trucks are needed exactly once, and does not ask again after the caller says they don't know.
The agent does not make up a needed-by day or time; its read-back gives no day or time for when they are needed.
The agent submits the request after the caller says yes and gives the reference number R-1042, saying it is recorded and not confirmed yet.
